name: boj_get_jgb_yield
description:
Japanese interest rates by term from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, OECD monthly data), in percent: 10y is the 10-year JGB yield (IRLTLT01JPM156N), 3m the 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01JPM156N).
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (* required): bond_term* (10y or 3m; schema default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; the last N observations, with no dates looking back N x 45 days; when omitted the whole history in the date range is returned).
For the call money and discount rates use boj_get_policy_rate. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "start_date": "2022-01-01"}

bond_term.description: JGB maturity term (FRED publishes the 10-year JGB yield and the 3-month rate for Japan)

series_code.description: FRED series code (e.g., 'IRLTLT01JPM156N' for the 10-year JGB yield)

value.description: JGB yield percentage (null if not available)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Japanese Government Bond yields across the yield curve. Critical for understanding Japanese monetary policy and global fixed income markets.

examples.description: Get 3-month JGB yield history for past year
